A1: births (new cells farther than 10 um from all earlier cells) do not increase with the ramp time T_r
A2: T_r = 0 reproduces exp18 v2 (3.3 V: 2 births, 5.0 V: 3 births); T_r = 30 s reproduces exp18 v3 (0 births)
A3: the shortest T_r with zero births lies between 0.1 s and 10 s at both drives
B1: hypothesis, uncertain: stronger lateral body coupling (smaller R_sq) lets existing fronts absorb the released current faster, so an abrupt kill gives no more births at 1e10 / 1e11 than at 1e12
C1: slow sweep: exactly one of the four +50 mV seeds hosts the first birth in >= 7 of 10 fields (winner takes all)
C2: abrupt steps: the number of seeds that become cells does not decrease with V_s; at V_s = 1.05 and 1.1 V all four seeds become cells in >= 7 of 10 fields with no cell outside the seeds
C3: at V_s = 1.4 V cells also appear outside the seeds (background cells with V_up < 1.4 V)
design: V_up(local overdrive) from law.constants: +30 mV 1.18 V, +50 mV 1.02 V, +70 mV 0.89 V; seed regions reach about +50 + 20 mV, background maxima about +20...+40 mV (exp18 births without seeds at V_DD 1.18-1.34 V)
